summary: OceanaGold Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The filing highlights safety, environmental, and community performance, and notes the appointment of David Bickerton as EVP and Chief Sustainability Officer. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management departure is described. This is a routine ESG disclosure with a normal executive appointment. No deal terms are present.
